column8: The pinned zonky.io embedded-postgres v16.4.0 Maven artifact fails provenance (detached GPG signature does not verify; signing key is an expired encryption-only subkey mismatched to the maintainer's published key) and ships no license/notice files despite bundling PostgreSQL plus OpenSSL/ICU/libxml2/libxslt/zlib/liblzma/OSSP-UUID. Owner decision 2026-11-01 (VD-p7-postgres-source-route-2026-11-01): the go-route is B1 — build PostgreSQL from the official signed postgresql.org source; zonky retired as the shippable path (dev/demo-only). Row stays OPEN/BLOCKED until the source build's provenance + component license/notice evidence is produced and accepted by a non-author verdict Owner decision 2026-11-05 (VD-p7-def001-resolve-2026-11-05): RESOLVED. The B1 route's three units are all non-author accepted — unit-1 SHA-256/official-domain-TLS source provenance, unit-2 minimal-permissive all-permissive build + two-dimension (dynamic+static-vendored) license/notice inventory, and unit-3 prepared-offline runtime fixture with the launched-process /proc witness (TWIN-INV-18) + LOCKED behavior-lock + PASS case-manifest over a real vera.replay.v1 proof. Unit 3 carries a non-author ACCEPTABLE package verdict AND a non-author §9.3a LIVE run (observed resolved_sha256==ba2447e5…fcd5; reproduced the committed LOCKED/PASS). RESOLVED closes the provenance/licensing-evidence deferral; the binary-exclusion law is UNCHANGED and this is NOT itself a release authorization.
